title: TAKE IT DOWN Act
status: Enacted — Public Law 119-12; FTC enforcement active
summary: Criminalizes specified nonconsensual publication of intimate visual depictions, including AI-created digital forgeries, and requires covered platforms to operate a notice-and-removal process and remove validly reported content and known identical copies within 48 hours.
committee_dynamics: The bill passed both chambers and became the first standalone federal law in this starter set with an express operational duty covering AI-generated intimate imagery.
advance_rationale: Enacted law; implementation replaces advancement forecasting.

deadlines.requirement: Covered platforms must establish the required notice-and-removal process.

agency_status.detail: The FTC began enforcing section 3, issued business guidance, contacted major platforms, and launched TakeItDown.ftc.gov.

verification_level: Official law and FTC implementation materials verified.
